items.title: The two canonical maps between the three ways of tensoring three modules are isomorphisms
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that the two displayed maps between (M tensor N) tensor P, the triple tensor product and M tensor (N tensor P) are well defined and isomorphisms (statement lines 2039-2051). The proof does not quote the associativity of the tensor product: it constructs the first map by fixing the third variable and applying bilinearity twice, constructs the inverse from the trilinear map on triples, and verifies the composites are identities by evaluating on pure tensors (proof lines 2053-2077). Deciding to peel off one variable at a time, so that only bilinearity is ever needed, is the content. H2.
